known.note: A declared .Opacity() change overrides a looping keyframe entry on opacity, which the model says holds the channel. Since spec 066 layer 2 the implicit transitions no longer throw here, so it shows with them too.

A declared .Opacity() change overrides a looping keyframe entry on opacity, which the model says holds the channel. Since spec 066 layer 2 the implicit transitions no longer throw here, so it shows with them too. The same with a facade Translation drag, which since layer 4 no longer changes the outcome; Translation.* drag cases are §9 row 3's.

A one-shot keyframe entry added while .Opacity() declares 0.8 finishes at its last value, 1, which overrides the declared opacity until it next changes. Since spec 066 layer 2 the implicit transitions no longer throw here, so it shows with them too.

A .Set facade Scale write mixed with modifiers or features: the setter re-runs and clobbers the declared value or is migrated by the handoff, and throws once the visual is taken.
A facade Translation drag mixed with .Translation(): since spec 066 layer 4 the modifier enables translation on the visual, after which WinUI ignores the drag once the element has rendered.
